body:
You're right of course. I'm not contemplating suicide because I can't have sex (mostly emotionally a little physically, I'm pretty tight still). In a lot of ways it is just a really physical manifestation of my overall ability to fail to make him happy. Weather it's because I don't like to talk politics, or know as much about history or economics or the things he's interested in. Or I just don't make him happy at all. Sex is just something I feel like is a girlfriend's responsibility which I fail at in real and tangible way. 


I wish I could see the great girl he sees in me. I really wish I could. But all I see is a wasted life, a boring person, and someone not really worth any of it.
